title: Container With Most Water：為什麼可以捨棄較短的牆
english_title: Container With Most Water: why the shorter wall can be discarded
description: 從面積公式與逐步狀態追蹤，推導為何可捨棄較短牆，並說明 two pointers 的正確性、Python 實作、複雜度與不等間距座標的改版。
english_description: Derive the shorter-wall discard rule from the area formula, then follow the two-pointer states, correctness proof, Python implementation, complexity and adaptation to unevenly spaced coordinates.

title: Course Schedule：計算尚未滿足的先修義務
english_title: Course Schedule: count the obligations that remain
description: 以 adjacency list、indegree 與 deque 追蹤尚未完成的先修義務，說明 Kahn's topological sort 如何判斷課程能否全部完成，並推導容器成本、複雜度與替代方案。
english_description: Track unfinished prerequisites with adjacency lists, indegree and a deque to explain how Kahn's topological sort decides whether all courses can finish, including container costs, complexity and alternatives.
